title: Capture sidecar
description: One record per capture, written by the capture app at the shutter press. Shape defined in ARCHITECTURE.md section 4. Records what was captured, never what was computed.

entrance_id.description: Canonical entrance ID: E- followed by exactly three digits (NFC, no surrounding whitespace). Same rule as frontdoor.split.canonical_entrance_id. Anchored with (?![\s\S]) rather than $ so a trailing newline is rejected under both Python re and ECMA-262 (TICK-229).

captured_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp. Z is required; offsets are rejected so capture time has one spelling. Format assertion is enabled in validate_sidecar (rfc3339-validator). Anchored with (?![\s\S]) rather than $ so a trailing newline is rejected under both Python re and ECMA-262 (TICK-229).

lens.description: The OPTICS that took the picture, e.g. builtInWideAngleCamera. Fixed at the 1x main lens by D-014. Not the same thing as capture_device: on a virtual device the main lens is reached through a device of another name, at that device's switch-over zoom factor.

depth.description: LiDAR depth map for this capture, or null when depth was unavailable (TICK-023 AC5). Absence must not cost an entrance.

distortion_table.description: Radial lens distortion lookup exactly as the camera delivered it: magnification factors sampled evenly from the distortion centre out to the farthest corner. Recorded verbatim and never applied on device -- undistortion belongs to the metrology library (TICK-042). ARCHITECTURE section 2 lists this as part of the method's legal input; it had no field until TICK-028, which meant no capture could carry it and Arms A and A-prime could not undistort a single tap.

distortion_center.description: The point the table is radial about, in the same pixel grid as cx and cy. Recorded separately because it is NOT the principal point: substituting cx and cy biases precisely the frame-edge corrections the table exists to make.

rise_in.description: Threshold rise in inches, read from the caliper at the entrance.

capture_device.description: The AVFoundation device type actually opened, e.g. builtInDualWideCamera. Recorded because the bare 1x wide camera delivers no calibration data on either team phone (TICK-020) and so cannot have produced any measurable frame -- a sidecar naming it as the device would be describing a capture that could not have happened.

zoom_factor.description: videoZoomFactor at the shutter. Required to make the D-014 claim checkable rather than asserted: on builtInDualWideCamera the scale is relative to the ultra-wide, so 2.00 IS the 1x main lens and 1.00 would be ~120 degrees of ultra-wide. Without this number the two are indistinguishable in the record.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest (hashlib.sha256().hexdigest()). Uppercase is rejected so a hash has one spelling in the manifest. Anchored with (?![\s\S]) rather than $ so a trailing newline is rejected under both Python re and ECMA-262.

point.description: Pixel coordinates [x, y] in the full-resolution image.
